title: psf-os: a self-checking layer between a user's circuit and an IBM heavy-hex device, without the calibration map
description: psf-os places a circuit by formula (a ring by the rule, a 2D circuit by translation of its own pattern), adds checks made of the user's own circuit to the same job (a floor, a mirror, a ring sentinel), keeps a list of what it found dead, and returns an answer card. It does not read a calibration quality number: it uses the coupling graph and the elements marked as failed. The declared device tests behind it are in https://github.com/TN-Holdings-LLC/psf-os-lab-notebook.
